title: Account acceleration 1:1 — quick jot
content:
Context
- Account: Hearthside Retail (mid-market, eCom vertical)
- ARR: ~ $380k annual; renewal Q3 2026
- Primary contacts: Priya (Head of ML), Marco (Platform Eng), Jenna (Head of Ops)
- Recent signal: token consumption down 28% last 6 weeks, spike in tail latency (p95 from 600ms -> 1.8s), 2 support escalations (S2) about timeouts in checkout flow
- Tier: growth customer on hosted API; currently on pay-as-you-go with small committed usage credits
- Risk: amber — usage decline + latency + procurement timeline uncertainty

Goal for this 1:1
- Align AE/CS/SE on immediate escalation playbook and next 30/60/90 day experiments to stabilize UX and demonstrate ROI.
- Decide whether to push Dedicated pilot or targeted config changes (batching/cache/quantization) first.
- Lock on owner + timeline for renewal touchpoints and exec sponsor intro.

Agenda (30 min)
- 0-4m: quick health recap (me)
- 4-12m: technical root causes and mitigation options (Liam/SE)
- 12-20m: commercial levers (AE) — credits, pilot pricing, SLA ask
- 20-27m: ask/next steps assignment + timeline
- 27-30m: wrap + sync on messaging to customer

Key points to raise (notes-to-self)
- Emphasize telemetry: p95/p99 latency jumps correlate with longer seq lengths on `checkout/price-approx` route; possible KV cache miss pattern after recent model update.
- Experiment idea A: roll back micro-model variant to last verified commit for 72 hours to measure latency/consumption delta (low risk).
- Experiment B: enable prefix caching for cart-init route + increase batching window by 10ms (tradeoff analysis).
- Commercial fallback: 6-week Dedicated pilot (2x reserved qps) with SLA credits if we miss p95 target; provide comparative cost delta.
- Messaging angle: "short-term stabilization + measurable test" rather than committing to full migration up-front.

Open questions we need answers for during/after 1:1
- Marco: can you share the last 2 model variants and the deploy timestamps? (asks SE)
- Priya: are there any internal A/Bs running that could confound traffic patterns?
- Billing: what thresholds trigger their procurement motion (who signs for Dedicated)? (asks AE)
- Telemetry: can SRE produce a heatmap of KV cache hit rates by route last 30 days?

Proposed owner map + actions (short-form)
- Samuel (me): draft 1-pager for customer framing (why transient pilot, expected metrics, ask) — due 2026-03-15
- Liam (SE): run quick stress run against `checkout` route with previous model build + collect p95/p99 and KV hit rates — due 2026-03-08
- Maya (AE): draft commercial outline for 6-week Dedicated pilot incl. estimated cost delta & trial SLAs; have internal pricing approval by 2026-03-10
- Noah (CS): prep customer-facing repro steps and checklist, schedule canary window with Hearthside next Tue (suggested) — due 2026-03-09
- Marco (customer): share deploy list + any feature flags by 2026-03-05 (ask in meeting)

Script snippets / objection handling (quick)
- If Priya worries about rollout risk: "We propose a 72-hour micro-rollback and a constrained traffic canary — low blast radius, measurable rollback metric. We'll own the orchestration and rollback at no charge for the pilot period."
- If procurement pushes back on Dedicated: "Let's treat Dedicated as an optional pilot — we'll produce explicit cost/latency delta so procurement can see the ROI. No multi-year lock unless they opt in."

Indicators of success (what we’ll measure)
- p95 latency on `checkout` route returns to <= 700ms (current target) within 72h of intervention
- KV cache hit rate improves by +15% on top-5 routes
- Token consumption stabilizes (less than 10% drop) and conversion (customer conversion metric) does not degrade
- Customer signs pilot acceptance doc or agrees to next executive intro by next quarterly touchpoint

Follow-ups to capture in notes during the meeting
- Exact deploy IDs Priya references (copy into ticket)
- Timestamp for first detected latency spike from their logs
- Any internal A/B or rollout windows that overlap our canary
- Specific procurement contact + gating checklist

Quick TODO (after meeting)
- Convert owners + actions into JIRA tickets and share link with Hearthside thread (Samuel)
- Run the rollback test and attach raw telemetry to Confluence page (Liam)
- Create short customer brief (1 pager) and get Maya to OK messaging before sending to Marco/Priya

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep tone collaborative; customer is sensitive to "vendor migration" language — avoid triggers like "full migration" early.
- Prioritize quick wins that show measurable latency improvement before discussing price/commitments.
- If we see no improvement in 72h, escalate to Eng leadership for deeper perf triage (flag: call with infra and serving-runtime on 3rd business day).

Unresolved items I want to prep before meeting (my checklist)
- Pull last 30 days: token volume by endpoint, p95/p99, KV hit rate per route — (Samuel/Liam)
- Draft pilot commercial calc: 6-week Dedicated cost vs current PAYG (Maya)
- Template email for exec intro and pilot summary (short) — ready to send if asked

-- end of jot --

(Will convert to formal Agenda + Jira after we align in 1:1)
